proof_attempt_summary: D-1 rejected the requested general necessary-and-sufficient boundary as circular and converged on a narrower matching-component success certificate, strict Li-separation witness, sharp open failure family, and matching-adaptive uncertainty branch. D0 discharged and maximized that graph, but D0.5 rated the package incremental with ceiling 6.4 below the 7.2 field bar and no bounded same-scope salvage. mathematical-soundness-unresolved / REVISE: the compact identification bridge and random singleton-separation premise remain load-bearing gaps; the calculus factor and two positioning findings also remain unrepaired, so this artifact is not publication-ready.
tldr: For the exact \(\alpha=1\) population-oracle analogue of GENE Equation (6), a primitive edgewise inequality on support-closed matching-component additive-noise models forces a positive reversal-correcting insertion at every wrong order, so best improvement and independence pruning recover the labelled DAG with a finite oracle-query budget. This is a certified success region, not a theorem for Li et al.'s full nonlinear class. For every \(\eta\in(0,1/2)\), an explicitly parameterized relatively open bivariate family, including a nonempty relatively open non-affine subfamily, makes the identifiable causal model \(X\to Y\) have the wrong order as its unique global and hence insertion-local maximizer with score advantage strictly greater than \(\eta\); the universal sharp supremum is \(1/2\). Cross-fitted simultaneous bands abstain at unresolved independence labels. The generic ambient-dimensional branch retains its sufficient sample size with the score-rate elbow at \(d=7\). On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{pair}}(d)\), a pairing-agnostic union of constant and univariate fits exploits structural regression dimension one, giving \(a_{n,\mathrm{pair}}=t_n^{3/7}\), \(w_R\lesssim t_n^{1/2}+t_n^{6/7}\), \(w_H\lesssim t_n^{1/2}+t_n^{3/7}\), and the sufficient singleton order \(n\gtrsim\log(M_d/\alpha)\max\{(d/\delta_{\mathrm{pair}})^2,\lambda^{-7/3}\}\), with no dimensional elbow and no minimax claim. HSIC separation only on the exact population execution suffices for \(1-\alpha\) coverage of \(G_0\) without width conditions; singleton recovery additionally needs all-compatible-query separation and the score and HSIC width inequalities.

fill: The pairwise forward-versus-reverse signal inequality yields a strict gain lower bound on support-closed matching-component ANMs. A six-node cosine--quadratic law proves strict separation from Li et al., and the resulting navigation theorem drives oracle recovery, query complexity, a calibrated positive witness, and margin-aware set-valued inference.
